scenes.title: Older Men
scenes.summary: The old have the opposite characters: they are positive about nothing, ill-natured and suspicious, love and hate by Bias' precept, are small-souled, ungenerous and cowardly, love life and themselves, live for advantage, are shameless, despondent and garrulous, weak in temper and appetite, and pity through weakness.

scenes.title: Speeches for Each Age
scenes.summary: Since everyone accepts speeches spoken in his own character, it is clear how the speaker can make himself and his speech appear such.
